text: Two men. One carried a bell.

speaker: meera
text: It rang. He hid it fast.

speaker: pujari
text: The old vaults. Behind the temple.

speaker: meera
text: They went to the old well. In this rain.

speaker: meera
text: Only one man carries those keys.

speaker: aryan
text: An empty case. The jungle road.

speaker: meera
text: Your jeep waits on the north road.

speaker: bhaskar
text: Do you know what this fetches?

speaker: madhav
text: I locked up myself. As always.

speaker: madhav
text: Take my lantern. It is dark below.

speaker: aryan
text: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to Jagannath Temple?

speaker: meera
text: Go straight along this road and follow the old stone entrance. The temple is at the end.

speaker: aryan
text: Dark down here. Watch your step.

speaker: aryan
text: The old well. Listen to that rain.

speaker: aryan
text: No shade at all out here.

speaker: aryan
text: I'm losing time. My notes might help.

speaker: aryan
text: Retrace it. What did I miss?

speaker: aryan
text: The jeep. Still in one piece.

speaker: aryan
text: Temple keys. All the way out here.

speaker: aryan
text: Enough to name someone. My notes.

speaker: aryan
text: Whole again. And it holds oil.

speaker: aryan
text: Three rings of light. Not by chance.

speaker: aryan
text: Too much. The panel's under water.

speaker: aryan
text: One beam. The wheel blocks the other.

speaker: aryan
text: There he is. Keep your distance.

speaker: aryan
text: Nobody else needs to get hurt.

speaker: robber
text: You should have stayed in the village.

speaker: robber
text: Two of us. One of you.

speaker: robber
text: He said nobody comes down here.

speaker: courier
text: You don't know who sent me.

speaker: kishore
text: Bhaskar will not wait for me.

speaker: madhav
text: The keys? Safe with me, always.

speaker: villager_m
text: The temple bell is silent tonight.

speaker: villager_f
text: We are praying for the festival.

speaker: narrator
text: Every temple holds a story. Every artifact carries a memory. Protecting heritage means protecting our history.
